gameDescriptionHtml:
Kun’tewiktuk: A Mi’kmaw Adventure is a fantasy adventure game inspired by Mi’kmaw legend and folklore. It takes place in Unama’ki (“Land of the Fog”), which is known today as Cape Breton Island, Canada. It chronicles the adventures of two young siblings Wasuek (“Flower”) and her brother U’n (“Fog”). The siblings get separated one summer morning and they go on an adventure through the spirit world to reunite.

Our game’s genre is best described as a fantasy adventure. It’s played in third-person perspective, and the player has access to a menu system that allows them to assign and switch weapons and abilities as they become available through the gameplay. The gameplay will sometimes weave back into the natural world, depending on the objective.

Our young adventurers will be granted special abilities as they progress through the game. These special abilities are drawn from nature and become available through the completion of assignments and quests.

Game Features

  • Legendary Encounters – Encounter a variety of characters from Mi’kmaw legend, including the Great Chief Kluskap, who will guide you on your journey… if you are worthy.
  • Minigames – The game will also feature a series of mini-games, testing the player’s skills in puzzles, memory, and dexterity.
  • Villains – The game’s villains and adversaries are inspired by Mi’kmaw legend and folklore. They include ogres, ice creatures, giant spirit animals, and much more.
  • Action – The game offers players a range of gameplay experiences, including both traditional weapons as well as magical abilities. It also offers different environments, landscapes, and gameplay as both of our young heroes.
  • Bosses – Players will face boss-level adversaries throughout the game.
